name: system-events
description: Shared catalogue of events a story's systems/*.json can opt into via a system's "events" block, each with a "frequency" whose meaning depends on the event's "kind": "special_asteroid" (rich_ore_vein) rolls per AsteroidField chunk as the player travels; "pirate_ambush" (lone_pirate) rolls once per system entry and, on a hit, spawns a hostile AI ship a short distance from the player with a tribute-or-fight hail (see game/screens/space_screen/pirates.py). Other kinds (wrecks, derelict ships, scannable anomalies, wormholes) are meant to land in this same catalogue later, each with its own spawn path (see setup.py's _build_system_events / _build_pirate_ambush_configs) without changing the config shape.
